#### Slack Logs

**Users**

This dashboard gives visibility into Slack Enterprise Grid user accounts collected for entity analytics. It highlights the number of unique users and groups and breaks users down by account type, role, multi-factor authentication, single sign-on, and user group. The tables list accounts and the Slack groups they belong to. Use the controls above to filter by user type, role, MFA, SSO, and group. Together, these panels offer an inventory view to support security oversight, auditing, and usage analysis.
